name: rozbazaar-platform
description: RozBazaar customer + vendor apps (React) and the TypeScript/Express API that sits in front of Supabase.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rozbazaar/shared && npm run build -w @rozbazaar/api -w @rozbazaar/customer -w @rozbazaar/vendor
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @rozbazaar/shared && npm run build -w @rozbazaar/api
